contract: Gathering (docs/design/gather_server_2026-10-11.md): switch Config.Features.Gathering off; 54 nodes (meadow 12 herb + 8 copper, woods 8 oak + 8 glowcap + 6 iron, ruins 6 silver + 6 moon crystal) in workspace.Map.GatherNodes, WorldKit GatherSpot parts replacing a zone's list, a GatherKit model or a walk-through stand-in on the ray-found ground; prompt GatherPrompt (the node's hold, 8 studs, no sight line, no words, ActionKey / ObjectKey, Enabled never touched); a gather = switch on, our node, alive + class + side, hold >= 0.8 x and began on this node (a release <= 1 s before the trigger), <= 12 studs, 1 a second, my 180 s rest, 400 a KST day (one DailyCap notice), no player hit (monsters fine), a full bag = nothing; 20% two; Gathered, GatherState { Ready (server time), N, Cap }, the artisan Fx, GatherFirst / GatherHeavy (once past 200 an hour); the Shard Bloom on plants (sure from the 5th gather, 8%, 3 a day, not over an open card): Share = 2 + 1 to everyone within 40 studs (10 gifts a day), Keep = 3, time up = 1 + BloomWilt, points through Deeds (none for artisans); LootService.GrantItems (known ids, 1..99, drop-shaped rows, one Loot Fx).
limitations: No real ProximityPrompt / hold UI (the prompt events are fired by the test), no Studio raycast against the real map, no client (GatherView is 게임성 개발 4's dev4-gather). Quests that count gathers (Gather goal) and the crafting recipes that use the materials come later.
